title: Frida Kahlo and the perils of fandom
gist: Using Tate Modern's Frida Kahlo show as a lens, Grace Spencer shows how fan culture, trademark licensing and AI tools like chatbots and voice cloning have eroded IP holders' control, while rights holders mostly embrace fandom as free marketing.

insights.claim: Tate Modern's Frida exhibition sold more than 41,000 tickets before opening, the highest pre-sale in Tate history, despite containing few actual Kahlo works.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Brand-driven cultural demand can outweigh content in exhibition economics.
insights.locator: In the final room of Tate Modern

insights.claim: There are more than 100,000 Kahlo objects on online platforms such as Amazon and Etsy, and the Frida Kahlo Corporation, founded in 2004, holds numerous US and UK trademarks and licenses to Puma, Converse, Shein and Amazon.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Illustrates scale of licensing economics around a deceased celebrity's image.
insights.locator: Fairly obscure in her own lifetime

insights.claim: The Corporation faces ongoing lawsuits from Kahlo's family over control, including a spat over the 2018 Kahlo Barbie, which was cleared for sale in Mexico in 2021 after a court ruled for the Corporation, and 2024 complaints against Amazon vendors and a dispute with FridaBaby.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Estate and trademark disputes are a recurring legal risk for image-licensing businesses.
insights.locator: The history of that commercialisation is a troubled one

themes.theme: AI and the loss of IP control

insights.claim: AI image, voice and chatbot tools (ElevenLabs, Character.AI) make appropriating images, voices and names by fans almost inevitable and controlling trademarks and copyright messier than ever.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Enforcement burden is rising for IP holders; watch for litigation and licensing deals with AI platforms.
insights.quote: It’s now almost inevitable that images, voices and names will be appropriated

insights.claim: Rights holders are pushing back on AI misuse: Michael Jackson's estate reportedly sent OpenAI a takedown demand over Sora videos, and the Motion Picture Association called on ByteDance to halt unauthorized use of US copyrighted works by Seedance 2.0.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Hollywood-versus-AI-video IP conflict is escalating, affecting ByteDance and OpenAI.
insights.locator: Amid the fast-moving swirl of AI-powered fandom

insights.claim: Most IP-holders now embrace fandom as free marketing, and Netflix's European marketing chief says teams are tasked to generate fandom and drive conversation; scholar Mel Stanfill sees an uneasy truce not yet broken by AI.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Fan-generated content is treated as a marketing asset, supporting engagement-driven business models.
insights.locator: Far from clamping down like Warner Bros tried to do

insights.claim: A 2024 YouTube report found 66 per cent of Gen Z Americans spend more time watching content that discusses or unpacks something than the thing itself, and fan studies scholar Paul Booth expects this to increase and fracture the media environment.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Commentary and derivative content is increasingly capturing attention relative to original IP.
insights.quote: more time watching content that discusses or unpacks something than the thing itself

insights.claim: Fan work is slowly monetising, with crowdfunding of fanfiction and fanart growing, particularly among younger adherents.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: A nascent creator-economy niche beyond traditional platforms.
insights.locator: Fridamania is also an early example

insights.claim: Memes and short-form edits strip context from original works and repurpose them, as with The Matrix's red pill and Patrick Bateman edits.
insights.speaker: Grace Spencer
insights.so_what: Brand-meaning drift is a risk for IP owners relying on viral engagement.
